judgments.verdict: The bench turns fast generation into touchable laws, pressure-tests and trails where intention stays legible.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether power faster than touch can become material where intention remains recognizable through resistance. Reading: The palette, living laws, rehearsal with tension marks, lineage and receipts carry that tension into connected choices. Other levels: Below would be motif repetition without a causal loop, above would need sustained alternatives and disagreement; falsified if rehearsal or receipts were decorative.

judgments.verdict: The workbench turns sparse prompts into placeable laws, pressure-tests, receipts and a live handoff where resistance stays visible and intention traceable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a world where effortless generation meets touchable resistance and intention stays recognizable at scale. Reading: The artefact carries that tension into linked choices — six placeable gestures, rehearsal against living laws, checksum receipts and a visible handoff. Other levels: Below would be motif repetition without causal loop, but rehearsal-tension-receipt connects; above would need sustained alternatives across scales, falsified if successor disagreements reshaped structure, which they do not.

judgments.verdict: The workbench turns fluency-versus-touch into placeable questions, testable laws and receipted trails where intention stays recognizable.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a world where fast generation is met by touch, resistance and recognizable intention at scale. Reading: The artefact carries that tension into connected choices—six placeable gestures, living laws, pressure-tests with tensions and checksum receipts. Other levels: One step down would be motif repetition if rehearsal is only self-report; one step up would need tensions sustained across distinct participants, falsified by showing other-authored proposals.

judgments.verdict: One hand authors gestures, laws and verdicts; no distinct intelligence contribution shapes the shared work.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a joint human-AI-material encounter where each side brings gestures and the portal holds a position. Reading: All gestures and assessments originate from one operator on a passive store, making an instrument not a relation. Other levels: Below would collapse even successor and material, above would need reciprocal proposal or refusal; falsified by any operational challenge from another participant.

judgments.verdict: All placing, verdicting and carrying is done by one browser operator on stored material with no intelligence proposing or refusing.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a portal becoming a participant with its own position meeting person and material both ways. Reading: Only the browser user places gestures and declares verdicts while material stores and maps, so the work remains instrument use. Other levels: Below would be absent roles, but person and material stay distinct; above would need intelligence proposal or refusal under constraints, falsified by any non-operator contribution path, none of which exists.

judgments.verdict: All placing, assessing and settling is done by one browser operator with no operational move by an intelligence counterpart.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a portal become a meeting where person, intelligence and material each bring purpose and trial. Reading: Only the operator acts; the intelligence never proposes, challenges or refuses, so the work is instrument use. Other levels: One step down (no roles) overstates because lineage distinguishes moves; one step up would need distinct contributions, falsified by logs of other-authored gestures.

judgments.verdict: The operator can bound, settle, refuse imports and start anew, but no second position can consent or withdraw.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether each participant can accept, limit or withdraw from a shared direction under declared constraints. Reading: Only operator choice and resource refusal are enacted through settle, seal checks and begin-again phrase. Other levels: Below would lack even those boundaries, above would require bilateral agreement for shared change; falsified by an intelligence refusal or revisable joint agreement.

judgments.verdict: Only the operator can bound, settle, refuse import or start anew, with no shared change requiring another side's agreement.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for shared change opening only when both accept and each can limit or withdraw. Reading: The operator can settle, refuse import and confirm anew, but no second position can accept, question or limit. Other levels: Below would be no boundary at all, but operator refusals exist; above would need bilateral agreement for mutation, falsified by finding a change requiring other-side consent, none of which occurs.

judgments.verdict: Only the operator can set limits or withdraw while the material can refuse corrupt imports, leaving no mutual agreement mechanism.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks each participant be able to accept, question, limit or withdraw from a shared direction. Reading: Operator choice and material import refusal exist, but no second position can bound or withdraw. Other levels: One step down (no boundary) ignores settle and import refusal; one step up would require bilateral agreement for change, falsified by requiring another's accept.

judgments.verdict: Moves meet inspectable strain against living laws and return as tension, notes and next threading.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a contribution can meet resistance, expose consequence and feed the next choice. Reading: Rehearse, strain counts, latest-rehearsal summary and thread-from-here form a coherent loop with receipts. Other levels: Below would be decorative feedback, above would connect local strain to wider propagation; falsified if verdicts never altered revision because all resistance is self-declared.

judgments.verdict: Moves meet declared laws through rehearsals that mark strains, show tensions and keep receipts feeding revision.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for contribution meeting resistance that exposes consequence returned into the next choice. Reading: Moves rehearsed against laws yield holds, unknown or strains with tension marks, inspector summaries and receipts guiding revision. Other levels: Below would be decorative feedback, but consequences are inspectable and counted; above would need local moves linked to wider propagation, falsified if tensions altered laws beyond marks, which they do not.

judgments.verdict: Moves can be pressure-tested against living laws, marked with tensions, threaded for revision and trailed by receipts.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks a contribution meet resistance that exposes consequence and returns into next choice. Reading: Rehearsal against alive laws yields holds/unknown/strains, tension marks persist, threading invites revision with receipts. Other levels: One step down would be decorative feedback if verdicts seen as only self-report; one step up would need wider propagation beyond the list, falsified if tensions never alter later moves.

judgments.verdict: A static local-first bench with verifiable portability is a coherent grounded answer to vast generativity.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for grounded medium and scope choices that make vast possibility touchable without an oracle. Reading: No build, account, network or AI, cache discipline, explicit non-cryptographic limits and rehearsal with unknown show source-grounded rationale. Other levels: Below would be weak seed connection, above would make rejected alternatives explicit; falsified if stack required what the contract forbids.

judgments.verdict: A static local-first workbench with six gestures, receipts, constellation and handoff gives a coherent source-grounded medium and scope.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for shaping laws by which a city safely grows and narrowing infinity with taste. Reading: The maker chose static local-first material, six gestures, receipts, constellation and handoff with contract-grounded rationale. Other levels: Below would be weak seed linkage, but laws and questions directly continue seed grammar; above would need explicit alternatives and limits, falsified if media comparisons or exclusions were stated, which apart from the integrity disclaimer they are not.

judgments.verdict: Choosing static local-first files with six gestures, rehearsals and an open thread shows purposeful source-grounded scoping.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks shaping laws for safe growth while staying able to touch the smallest bolt. Reading: No build/account/network/AI plus gestures, constellation, receipts and next question form a coherent rationale. Other levels: One step down (weak link) is implausible given carried laws; one step up would need explicit alternatives weighed, falsified by absence of rejected options.

judgments.verdict: Several relations survive as structure with clear transforms, though joint agency narrows to one hand.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks what survives, transforms or is lost when conjecture becomes artefact. Reading: Question, constraint, invariant, boundary, rehearsal and trail remain traceable in behavior despite witness substitution and lost other. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary without structure, above would make additions and the missing companion explicit; falsified if mapping relied on words alone without enacted consequences.

judgments.verdict: Gesture grammar, resistance, trails and open thread survive as working structure while the bilateral encounter narrows to solo instrument use.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for gestures, turn, joy and portal-becoming to survive as structure not words. Reading: Grammar, touch placeholders, rehearsal loop, workbench naming and open thread remain traceable in behavior, while joint agency narrows to solo use. Other levels: Below would be vocabulary only, but rehearsal, receipts and lineage enact; above would need relational depth plus explicit additions and omissions, falsified by absent second participant and unmarked narrowing.

judgments.verdict: Several seed relations become working structure while the two-sided encounter narrows to a single-handed instrument.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks its meeting-grammar to survive as behaviour even with its words removed. Reading: Laws, rehearsal, receipts and lineage do become structure, but bilateral acceptance does not. Other levels: One step down (words only) underplays working assessments; one step up would need full relational depth with omissions explicit, falsified if artefact claimed jointness it enacts.

judgments.verdict: Stored state, visible thread and verifiable carry let a successor recover intent and redirect with reasons.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks whether a successor can recover intention and change direction while keeping earlier work legible. Reading: Visits, handoff on return, lineage, constellation and sealed import support a recoverable next move that invites replacement. Other levels: Below would be a described step without usable entry, above would reopen several joint directions; falsified if state were unreadable or the question forced a binary answer.

judgments.verdict: Stored visits, visible handoff, receipt history and verified portable snapshots let a successor resume and redirect the work.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for a next hand to recover intention and redirect while earlier work stays legible. Reading: Visits, handoff thread, receipt history and sealed snapshots with verified import support resume and replacement. Other levels: Below would be a described step without entry, but storage and export execute; above would need several grounded directions reopening joint relation, falsified by the single nextMove string and no joint re-entry.

judgments.verdict: Stored visits, visible handoff, sealed portable snapshots and living-edge notes let a later hand recover and redirect the work.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed leaves open who decides next while keeping earlier work legible and revisable. Reading: Handoff on return, editable thread with receipt, visits and verifiable export support recoverable redirection. Other levels: One step down (described step without entry) is refuted by importable JSON; one step up would need several directions reopening joint relation, falsified by successor inviting refusal.

judgments.verdict: Tactile language, palette, lineage map, receipts and accessible responsive forms cohere as usable touch.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for forms where questioning, shaping and trailing intention become perceptible together. Reading: Serif prompts, kind colors and glyphs, constellation, receipt trail, keyboard and reduced-motion handling work as one consequential interaction. Other levels: Below would be fragmented communication, and failure would be obscuring the relation; falsified if beauty masked that one hand performs all gestures.

judgments.verdict: Language, palette, layout, constellation and tactile styling with keyboard, motion, narrow-screen, print and offline care form one usable whole.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks for bending radiance into touchable form where asking and exploring feel like the hand. Reading: Palette glyphs and colors, composer, lineage, constellation, receipts and paper-ink styling cohere with keyboard, reduced-motion, narrow, print and offline handling. Other levels: Below would be fragments, but forms interoperate to make touch perceptible; a lower choice would be falsified by the working keyboard, motion and offline paths, which are enacted not merely declared.

judgments.verdict: Palette, composer, constellation, receipts and tactile styling with keyboard, narrow-screen and offline care form a coherent perceptible world.
judgments.rationale: Lens: The seed asks asking and exploring to be felt as the hand's gesture across language, structure and media. Reading: Tool-rail, bench, inspector, dialogs, paper system, motion/contrast/keyboard/narrow/print and cache work together accessibly. Other levels: One step down (fragments) is refuted by integrated views; joint presence remains unexpressed, which would falsify wholeness if expression must show the other hand.

presentation.title: From conjecture to continuation
presentation.summary: Rubric judgments resolve 8 of 8 axes from 3 independent evidence sessions; each axis has its own quorum.
findings: Core recognition: Carries the central tension into several connected choices.
Shared agency: A single operator acts on an instrument.
Mutual consent: Operator choice or resource refusal is represented.
Consequential touch: Rehearsal, resistance and revision form a coherent loop.
Independent judgment: Medium, scope and choices have a coherent source-grounded rationale.
Fidelity through change: Several source relations remain traceable through design and behaviour.
Open continuation: State, intention and an open question support a recoverable next move.
Expressive coherence: Expression and consequential interaction form a coherent, accessible whole.
